title: Chapter 544
paragraphs: Chapter 544
Episode 145. Omen (13)
"Sire!"
"Sire...!"
All the knights of Hairan simultaneously knelt on one knee.
Facing an overwhelming enemy they couldn't handle, they all turned their backs and bowed their heads to Ron.
This would never be acceptable in times of war. However, the knights could not help but express their faith and respect at his appearance in such a desperate situation.
Because with him, even Kelliark Zipfel couldn't recklessly attack the Sword Emperor's Castle. The knights barely suppressed their intensely burning emotions.
Step by step...
As Ron took steps forward, the knights stood up and resumed their positions. Even though he wasn't exerting any force, both the enemy and allies could hear his footsteps as their own heartbeats.
Jin, standing beside him, saluted respectfully, and Ron grabbed his shoulder once.
"I owe you another debt, Paul Grey Mick."
Jin smiled at Ron's use of his alias. Somehow, he felt very close to the unparalleled giant known as Ron Hairan.
"I believe you'll repay me whenever you can."
Don't die and make sure to repay me alive, Ron read the underlying meaning in Jin's words and chuckled.
"Sword Master of Hairan, Luyan."
Then he looked for Luyan.
"Yes, sire!"
"Answer me. As the acting commander of the Sword Emperor's Castle, were you planning to accept Kelliark's conditions?"
"Absolutely not."
Luyan answered without hesitation.
She had absolutely no intention of accepting Kelliark's conditions. That would be betraying the Vamel Alliance, which had been fighting for Hairan, and it would be a humiliation to Hairan itself.
The reason why the Sword Emperor's Castle was momentarily swayed by Kelliark's words was simply because of the fact that Zipfel knew a way to save the Crown Prince.
Ron seemed satisfied and nodded, replying,
"Well done. And you've held out splendidly."
Luyan felt as if she was choking at Ron's sincere compliment.
Because she thought she had done nothing.

Before Ron stood up, she could do nothing against Kelliark's Zipfel, and she hadn't prevented the Crown Prince from being so seriously injured in the first battle. If it weren't for Jin, Hairan would have fallen long ago, and she was just a figurehead...
Not only Luyan, but all the knights of Hairan felt the same. They thought that if they had been more competent, the Sword Emperor's Castle would not have been reduced to such a laughable state.
"Knights of Hairan, that feeling is my responsibility too. So stop blaming yourselves, and accept the late order of the guilty Lord of the Sword Emperor's Castle."
"…We will follow any order."
"Dragon Knight Commander, Kalmain Aita."
"Speak, sire."
Kalmain responded, gripping his sword with his left arm. He intuitively knew what order Ron was about to give.
"The Dragon Knights should immediately take all the knights of Hairan, excluding the Sword Masters, and leave the Sword Emperor's Castle."
Kalmain didn't resist the command.
In the battle that was about to begin, it was clear that neither he nor the knights below the Sword Masters would be of any real help.
However, even if the knights of Hairan weren't necessary for the current battle,
They were essential for the 'reconstruction'.
They didn't leave the castle when Ron was unconscious, facing certain death, because they had no future.
But now they could think about the future. They absolutely had to prepare for the future. People were needed to welcome the return of the Lord and the Crown Prince.
"Dragon Knight Commander Kalmain Aita, I will follow your command."
Suppressing the fervent desire to fight and die together, Kalmain saluted Ron with his sword.
"Ron Hairan…."
Around that time, Kelliark opened his eyes narrowly and spoke.
"I didn't think you'd wake up. I thought you had already gone to hell."
"I just came back after checking that your brothers and sons are doing well."
Kelliark's phoenix, Belot, had been showing fierce hostility from the moment Ron first appeared. Ron alternated between looking at Kelliark and Belot while stroking his beard.
"You seemed to be quite looking forward to maybe going there soon. Unfortunately, your summon, who cut off my neck and wings, won't be able to join us due to its immortality."
Roar!
Suddenly, Belot's two wings swelled up. It was trying to bind the Sword Emperor's Castle in flames according to Kelliark's will.
In an instant, the wings, which had grown as large as a ship, wrapped around the Sword Emperor's Castle.
The enveloped wings, which continued to vomit fire and swell without rest, seemed to melt the Sword Emperor's Castle whole at any moment.
"Do you think I will allow your knights to escape?"
Ron slowly drew Rashid from his waist.
Swoosh… In the thick flames that filled the entire field of view, the sound of Rashid's blade leaving the sheath was unusually cold.
The shining blade of Rashid cut through the air once, causing a silent ripple.
Then, an invisible wind poured out in all directions from the sword.
Tens of thousands of formless sword winds began to slowly push away Belot's flame.
Belot roared, folding his spreading wings, but Ron, even in the midst of the escalating clash of forces, did not lose his calm demeanor at all.
At that moment, Kelliark could not help but fall into a foreboding question.
'Could it be... has Ron surpassed the wall...?'
Transcendence.
A realm of absoluteness allowed only to Chiron. For a moment, Kelliark could catch a glimpse of the realm Chiron had reached from Ron.
Though the hand holding Rashid was so thin that one could hardly imagine its owner being the Sword Emperor due to long illness and unconsciousness,
And his body had become so emaciated that it couldn't be covered even with clothes,
Now, the achievement of being the Sword Emperor was revealing a stronger light and majesty than ever before. Even Kelliark Zipfel would have mistaken him for standing in Chiron's realm for a moment!
'No, Ron is still... He hasn't reached him yet.'
If he hadn't experienced Chiron firsthand, Kelliark would have been sure. That Ron had finally set foot in the land of Transcendence.
The reason Kelliark didn't fall into fear and helplessness now was purely because Chiron existed in the world.
Transcendence is a realm that only Chiron has proven, and the power that Ron is showing now has not reached that proof.
Even so, chills surged through his body as if thunder was rushing through it, and his senses were cold as if a blade had already entered his back.
Not only Kelliark, but everyone was shocked. The dragons and mages of the fleet, the allies, even Runcandel who was observing the situation from afar, and Talaris who was guarding the seal of Dante.
Especially the phoenix Belot, who was directly struggling with Ron, was at a point where he simply couldn't accept the fact that his arch-nemesis who had cut off his wings had become so strong.
[Kahaak-!]
Eventually, Belot's wings, which had wrapped around the Sword Emperor's Castle, spread out and tore apart.
Belot screamed in agony, and the flames of the torn wings fell to the ground like hailstones.
The strongest phoenix summoned by the absolute master of magic was thus experiencing the humiliation of having its wings torn off by the same person again.
Moreover, Ron had not yet swung his sword even once.
The Zipfel's main force couldn't believe what they were seeing, the result of Ron simply drawing his sword and showing his energy.
Belot revealed his resentment as if he was crazy, repeatedly shrinking and spreading his diminished wings, and Kelliark felt a single invisible sword wind brush past his neck.
"...You've become strong, Ron Hairan."
"I wasn't just lying around doing nothing."
"Is it the power of the white stone?"
"No, it's the power of Hairan that's defeating him."
Jin took note of Ron's meaningful words.
-This is a boundary derived from rejecting chaos. Your friend, Ron's grandson, is now fighting against chaos within himself. So there's no reason for me to fulfill my mission yet.
The inner battle that Dante was fighting against chaos began after he personally owned the white stone, following the voice of the white stone that Ron had been holding.
Of course, until then, it was Ron Hairan who was fighting the chaos of the white stone.
Through that intense and terrifying long fight, Ron had reached a new level.
The power of Hairan that's 'defeating him'.
That's exactly what it meant.
'The chaos of the white stone couldn't beat Sir Ron and tempted Dante. Or it was defeated by Sir Ron and moved on to Dante.'
Maybe, just like Ron, Dante might also win the fight with the white stone. There was a sense of expectation that his friend could shake it off and come back.

"Either way, if I lose in a fight with you, my retreating knights will eventually meet their death. So, how about you just let them go, ready to defeat me no matter what? It would look better when historians record this fight in the future."
Kelliark showed no particular reaction to Ron's provocation.
"Record of history... That's an interesting story. It will be recorded according to the winner's will, anyway. If it makes you look good, I won't interfere."
"Today is the first day we've ever had a conversation since we met."
Kelliark shook off the seal of fire engraved in the air with his rod.
"Knights!"
Ron turned around and shouted at the Hairan knights still facing him. His deep voice shook the sky.
Then all the knights saluted with their swords, gritting their teeth. To hold back the tears.
"I, Ron Hairan, the Lord of the Sword Emperor."
Ron slowly raised his sword salute towards the knights.
That was not to accept the knights' courtesy as the Lord of the Sword Emperor, but a sincere salute from a late sinner to those who had never betrayed Hairan, as a lesser man.
"I sincerely thank and respect you all who are leaving Hairan for Hairan."
Enduring a pain worse than broken bones and skinned flesh, all the Hairan knights were able to hold back their tears.
If they cried now, it would feel like this was truly the end. They could hold back because of that.
When Kalmain lowered his sword, the knights followed and lowered their swords, and Ron continued his sword salute.
"......Hairan! Everyone, follow the Dragon Knights and... retreat."
Following Kalmain's command, all the knights retreated, and only after their backs disappeared beyond the collapsed cliff at the back gate.
Ron released his sword salute and looked back at the battlefield again. The desolate battlefield filled with enemies.
